epic.title: Post-phase-1 mechanisms + cleanup (epic #418)
epic.intent_and_why: Phase 1 left two problems: a bloated backlog, and two mechanisms that keep slipping. The context governor still produces zero readings on live runs, and role instructions are still front-loaded into always-loaded prose instead of being pushed to the agent by the spine at the gate where they matter. This epic is the mechanisms-plus-cleanup stage: make the frame hold, then clean the decks. Done looks like a governor writing real per-agent readings on a live run with the engine's trip mechanic acting on them; an engine output channel that carries each instruction exactly once and renders every populated gate block; the named prose-only invariants refusing instead of hoping; a backlog short enough that every surviving issue ties to the target architecture or a real defect, checkable by one issue-list sweep; and an agent driving a real role spine end to end through an MCP door.

definition_of_done: The governor writes real per-agent readings on a live run and the engine's trip mechanic acts on them.
The engine's current output carries each instruction exactly once and renders every populated gate block.
The named prose-only invariants (#329 worktree isolation, #328's two record() surveys) refuse instead of hoping.
The backlog is short enough that every surviving open issue ties to the target architecture or a real defect, checkable by one issue-list sweep.
An agent drives a real role spine end to end through the MCP door, each agent holding its own server instance.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Every threshold and durable choice is graded guess or placeholder unless someone actually measured it; a check that cannot register its own failure is a defect, not a pass.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Each issue carries independently observable acceptance evidence gated on a real command exit code.
good_enough.appetite: First-round good-enough over better-later; build what needs to work and do not chase corner cases.

hard_constraints: Scope discipline narrows breadth, never evidence; a declined corner case gets a comment at the code site and is floated up, never silently absorbed.
Vision work, performance-metrics methodology, and the simplified-English thread are ruled out of this design.
fixed_decisions: Episodes are a record of what happened, not a playbook; nothing may read them back as a rule.
Launched issue identities remain stable once a Commander is dispatched against them.
Wave boundaries are stop-and-present checkpoints; the Admiral does not roll into the next wave unilaterally.

current_wave.objective: Land the governor and engine-channel mechanisms, wire the named invariants, and finish the episode-store retirement.
exit_criteria: A HARD trip fires from a per-agent reading on a live dispatched agent, and the reading lands in the tree that agent is actually working in.
Both shared record ledgers are retired behind a guard that is observed failing before it is observed passing.

issues.title: Governor: per-agent identity so subagent readings are attributed and trip
issues.desired_outcome: Every agent, subagents included, is tracked under its own identity and readings actually appear.
issues.useful_now: Zero readings on live runs is the defect that blocks every other governor decision.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A HARD trip fires live on a dispatched subagent and the engine refuses its advance; a control arm produces no reading.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the identity-resolution mechanism; preserve the fail-safe that a missing gauge never forces a handoff.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Gauge failures collapse to None and never force a handoff.

issues.title: Engine output channel: de-dup the RAIL echo, render anchors and constraints
issues.desired_outcome: current carries each instruction exactly once and renders every populated gate block.
issues.useful_now: Blocks C: relocated instructions cannot reach agents through a channel that drops them.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A golden test across all six RAIL verbs shows single-echo output with anchors and constraints rendered.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the rendering approach; a de-duplication that cannot be done truthfully is an honest null, not a licence to ship a lying pointer.

issues.title: Wire the prose-only invariants: #329 worktree isolation and #328's record() surveys
issues.desired_outcome: The named checks refuse instead of hoping.
issues.useful_now: Prose invariants are the class of check that cannot register its own failure.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A deliberate-breakage test passes: the wired check refuses the broken case.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose where the checks live; they must fail closed.

issues.title: File the explorer run's triage-candidate defects
issues.desired_outcome: Every triage candidate the explorer surfaced exists as a tracker reference.
issues.useful_now: Findings banked in a run artifact are invisible to the tracker sweep the epic's done-condition depends on.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: Each candidate resolves to a tracker reference; no code change is expected.

issues.title: Governor: a worktree-dispatched agent's binding records a main-checkout path
issues.desired_outcome: A dispatched agent's reading lands beside the spine it is actually driving, not in a phantom directory in the main checkout.
issues.useful_now: #419 proved the trip can fire; this decides whether it fires where the work is. Without it the governor is unusable in the worktree topology every epic runs in.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A two-arm sandbox where treatment refuses the worktree-dispatched agent's advance and the control arm is shown to have produced a real gauge.json with fill at or above hard at the wrong path.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the root-resolution strategy; refuse to guess when candidate roots disagree.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Never hand-inject the value being proved; the hook must derive the root.
The control arm must be a positive control: a merely quiet control is worthless.

issues.title: Finish #308's retirement: episodes replace both LESSONS.md and AGENT_FEEDBACK.md
issues.desired_outcome: One store of observations replaces two inboxes plus a playbook, with a guard that keeps the read path retired.
issues.useful_now: The retirement was declared but not completed; two shared ledgers still ship, still collide on every merge, and still instruct agents to read them.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A shipped guard observed failing on purpose before it is observed passing, and both ledgers untracked.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the guard's mechanism and the untracking sequence.
hard_constraints_no_gos: No successor playbook is created; a retirement that re-points the read path at episodes/ reproduces the defect.
Record stores are never hand-edited; episodes/ is written only through apply_episode_delta.py.

wave_evidence.claim: The governor writes real per-agent readings on a live run and the trip mechanic acts on them.
wave_evidence.expected: A dispatched agent's context fill produces a reading that the engine trips on.
wave_evidence.observed: True for identity and for the trip itself (#419), but the reading is written against the main checkout's path even when the agent is dispatched into a worktree, so it lands in the wrong tree. Separately, an Admiral session bound to three candidate spines gets no reading at all: the writer hook refuses to guess and writes nothing.
wave_evidence.source: #419's live two-arm evidence; #440's reproduction; the CONTEXT GAUGE SILENT notice on this epic's own spine, flagged 27h32m before it was read

wave_evidence.claim: The backlog is short enough that every surviving open issue ties to the target architecture or a real defect.
wave_evidence.expected: Open-issue count falls materially below the 117 the epic opened against.
wave_evidence.observed: 138 open issues, of which 40 carry no theme label. The epic has generated roughly twenty new findings (#427-#433, #436-#437, #439, #440-#444, #446, #447, #448-#451) against four issues closed under E's batch confirm. Net direction is up, not down.

wave_evidence.claim: Theme labelling for backlog consolidation does not exist and would have to be created from scratch.
wave_evidence.expected: No theme labels in the repo, per the epic's own state note.
wave_evidence.observed: Thirteen theme:* labels now exist and are applied to about 98 of 138 open issues. The state note is stale on this point.

wave_evidence.claim: A well-run epic can close its own archive gate on the success path.
wave_evidence.expected: The archive gate closes when the work is merged.
wave_evidence.observed: The gate's check is the literal string gh pr list --head <branch>, with the placeholder never resolved, and it accepts only an OPEN PR — so a merged epic fails it and is forced to --force.
wave_evidence.source: #439 and #446; observed directly in the Commander spine template
